question: Kojagiri Poornima is a festival celebrated primarily in _______ on the full moon day of Ashwin month.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kojagiri Poornima** is a festival celebrated primarily in **Maharashtra**__ on the full moon day of the Ashwin month.
 
• It is also known as **Sharad Poornima** and marks the end of the monsoon season.
 
• On this day, people stay awake all night, gazing at the moon and consuming a special preparation of milk.
 
• The festival is celebrated with great enthusiasm and is often associated with the worship of the goddess Lakshmi for prosperity and well-being.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• In some regions, **Sharad Poornima** is also celebrated by preparing and consuming a special dish called **‘Dudh Poha’** made from flattened rice and milk.
 
• It is believed that the moon on this night is closest to the earth and its rays have healing properties.
 
• The festival has a cultural significance as it brings communities together and reinforces social bonds.
